summary: Gate 3 Aug. 28-Sep. 1 evidence increment: sanctions enforcement, renewed direct kinetics, Mecca institutionalization and tanker attacks.

sources.title: Treasury Launches Unprecedented Campaign Against Iranian Regime on Economic D-Day
Iran’s Access to UAE Banks Targeted Under Operation Economic Outcast
Explosion heard near Iran's Larak Island; U.S. official says two launchers struck
Iran's IRGC says it launched attack on two U.S. bases in Jordan
Turkey, Saudi Arabia, Pakistan hold first defence pact meeting
Saudi Arabia, Turkey, Pakistan agree to establish secretariat under joint defence pact
CENTCOM Completes Strikes on IRGC Targets in Iran
Two tankers carrying Saudi oil attacked in Strait of Hormuz

events.summary: Treasury escalated Operation Economic Outcast by proposing to revoke Banque Misr UAE's U.S. correspondent access and sanctioning additional Iran-linked financial actors.
events.adjudication_note: Establishes initial implementation/enforcement. Treasury assertions about the scale of Iranian wrongdoing remain actor claims unless independently corroborated.

events.summary: The United States struck two Iranian launchers on Larak Island after reporting preparations connected to rockets and sea-mining activity; Iran subsequently claimed retaliation against U.S. bases in Jordan.
events.adjudication_note: Ends the late-July direct-strike lull. Iranian retaliation claims must be separated from independently established impacts.

events.summary: Saudi Arabia, Türkiye and Pakistan moved the Mecca defense pact into institution-building by establishing a Saudi-based secretariat after the first committee meeting.
events.adjudication_note: Upgrades current state from a signed pact to institution-building; does not establish displacement of existing U.S.-Saudi defense ties.

events.summary: CENTCOM completed a wave of strikes on IRGC air-defense sites, radar systems, maritime assets/facilities, mine-laying capabilities and communications sites.
events.adjudication_note: Target categories are confirmed as U.S. action; claimed success/effect is not converted into independently verified BDA.

events.summary: VLCCs Sidr and Senegal Prosperity, carrying Saudi oil, were struck by unknown projectiles near Khasab/Oman minutes apart; crews were reported safe.
events.adjudication_note: Attribution remains unknown; do not assign Iran absent additional evidence.
